## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen.

## Milestone fit

Which milestone does this belong to (`docs/22-ROADMAP.md`)? Please note that
WiseEvidence builds in order and avoids premature later-milestone features.

## Domain-rule considerations

Does this touch how evidence is represented? Remember the platform keeps
outcome, quality, confidence, criticism, and provenance **separate**, and treats
AI as an assistant rather than the final authority. Note any impact here.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context

Links, references, or mockups. Significant architectural changes will need an
ADR (`docs/adr/`).
